title: Models and Analyses — a KIND app organized by project and arc
review_protocol: Written single-pass in Draft Mode on 2026-09-23. Chris edits fullprompt.md in place, annotating with (CSH - ...) or (CSH : ...) markers; /ai-design --review kind-model-analysis-explorer-v1 diffs the working tree against draft_commit, classifies every hunk, propagates decision changes through body, stories, testing decisions and taskplan, re-derives the Gotchas section, and recommits with a fresh baseline. The PRD may not advance to ready until review_rounds >= 1.

hard_external_dependency.module: kbutillib.koros_arc_store, plus kbutillib.koros_arc_store_testing (FakeKorosArcStore) and the CAC helpers
hard_external_dependency.why: REVISED 2026-09-24. Two PRDs designed in parallel share one project/arc layer that must be built exactly once. It was originally assigned to kind-annotation-results-explorer-v1 on the grounds that Chris would likely build that app first. Chris then chose EXTRACTION -- the recommendation this PRD made in review round 1 -- so the layer now has its own PRD and NEITHER app creates it.
hard_external_dependency.blocks: Every task in this taskplan. Nothing here is dispatchable until kbutillib.koros_arc_store is on KBUtilLib main.
interface_this_prd_is_written_against: KorosArcStore.record_analysis(project, arc, rec, detail=None) -- upsert on record_id; a RETRY (same run_uid) replaces, a RE-RUN (new run_uid) is a new dated row
KorosArcStore.list_analyses(project, arc, kind=None, analysis_id=None, latest_only=False) -- kind and analysis_id combine CONJUNCTIVELY; latest_only returns one row per analysis_id
KorosArcStore.delete_record(record_id) -> bool -- deletes ONE run; False for an unknown record_id
KorosArcStore.read_detail(record_id) -> dict | None -- None for a record with no blob, RAISES RecordNotFound for an unknown record_id; the two are NOT the same
AnalysisRecord(record_id, analysis_id, run_uid, kind, created_at, producer, subject, status, trust_tier, provenance, contract_version, artifacts, payload) -- run_uid REQUIRED
the shared analysis_id/record_id derivation helper and the trust_tier floor helper
FakeKorosArcStore from kbutillib.koros_arc_store_testing -- the app tests import this rather than writing their own double
exceptions by NAME: KorosArcStoreError, RunsRootResolutionError, RecordValidationError (stable `code`), RecordNotFound, ContractVersionMismatch
hard_external_dependency.seam_that_must_not_change: an opaque `payload` dict under a NAMESPACED `kind` string; names may move, the seam may not
hard_external_dependency.repo_slot_caveat: KBUtilLib is both this module's repo and this app's repo, so under dev 1032 one-branch-per-repo this PRD cannot start while koros-arc-store-v1 is building. kind-annotation-results-explorer-v1 has no such collision -- after the extraction its repos union is KBDLJobRunningPrototype + GenomeAnnotationAggregator only. The two consumers are NOT symmetric in the build order even though the dependency graph says they are.
corrections_inherited_2026_09_24: S4/S7: record_analysis gains an optional detail parameter; runs gains a nullable payload column; the summary columns are optional producer-supplied fields on AnalysisRecord, not computed by the store.

S11: contract_version gating implements INTEGER COMPARISON ONLY -- equal proceeds, any difference hard-fails naming both versions, NO minor/warn branch. The contradiction is upstream in the CAC, verified by reading it: the wire field is ruled an integer at :141/:173/:252 while section F at :290 describes semver major/minor gating and marks the mechanics an unfilled placeholder at :294. This PRD's p3 success criterion previously required the warn-on-minor behaviour and has been corrected.
S12: id normalisation applies to APP IDS ONLY and must never be applied to kind, subject or record_id.

S5: the store holds no list of kinds; unknown_kind is set for a malformed kind, or for a well-formed kind outside a caller-supplied known_kinds set. This app's own foreign-prefix counting (p3) is a SEPARATE concern and is unchanged.

external_research.bears_on: Q1 (record schema — question C asks whether RO-Crate or an MLflow-style index is the standard envelope) and Q3 (question A, Escher web-embedding gotchas)
external_research.honest_note: Dispatched BEFORE authoring began, per the research split; returned mid-draft and folded before commit. The Research Report quality section states which recommendations were accepted and which declined, and why.
external_research.verdict: Build it: 'No existing open-source tool provides the exact PROJECT -> ARC -> multi-model drill-down with Escher overlays and fitness agreement as described.'
recommendations_accepted: JSONL failure modes and mitigations: O_APPEND, advisory lock, single-write lines, tolerate truncated final line, last-writer-wins on record_id; SQLite/duckdb past a few MB or thousands of records
Escher: sandboxed iframe needs BOTH allow-scripts and allow-same-origin; do not embed multi-MB map JSON in the payload; enable_search=false on large maps
Agreement metric: confusion matrix with MCC, precision, recall (Q14)
recommendations_declined: RO-Crate as the record envelope -- declined in Q1: PROVENANCE.json already describes the arc, and RO-Crate describes a crate rather than an append-many log of runs
Cross-model ID harmonization via MNXref/BiGG -- unnecessary: create_fitness_dashboard already keys purely on ModelSEED reaction ids and is documented cross-genome
Instantiating escher.Builder ourselves -- we delegate rendering entirely

was.the_change: Chris reversed the re-run behaviour in koros-arc-store-v1: re-runs no longer collapse to one row. Identity is SPLIT -- analysis_id (sha256 over kind + subject + significant_params, the old record_id derivation, now the GROUPING key) and record_id (sha256(analysis_id + NUL + run_uid), one row per run). delete_record(record_id) -> bool added. koros-arc-store-v1 is READY at draft_commit 7660ccd3.
